en.title: KOL vault
en.description: 100% of the trading tax lands here. At each market-cap milestone the vault buys the payout token and books an equal share for every KOL on the list. KOLs claim when they want.

en.rules.tax: Tax runs for 30 days after launch. It is sold for BNB during sells and reaches this vault when anyone (or the KabalKult relayer) calls dispatch().
en.rules.marketCap: Market cap uses the current pool price, so one large buy can reach a milestone.
en.rules.size: Each milestone pays its share of the BNB in the vault at the moment it is paid; tax that arrives later goes to later milestones. The last milestone pays everything left. Milestones reached together pay together.
en.rules.purchase: Mock stocks are bought from the StockDesk at the CoinMarketCap price. Other tokens are bought on the DEX with no minimum price, so a large payout can get a bad price. If the payout token can't be bought, that payout is in BNB instead.
en.rules.kols: Named KOLs are paid with or without confirming; confirming only adds a public badge. The creator can invite more wallets at any time, and each new KOL shares later payouts.
en.rules.expiry: If no milestone is reached, the tax stays in the vault for good.
en.notices.payAnyone: Anyone can pay a reached milestone. You pay the gas; the KOLs get the payout.
en.notices.unknownToken: This payout token isn't one of the mock stocks. Amounts are shown with 18 decimals; check the token's decimals on the explorer.
